data.name: Basic Pyrokinesis
data.description: Element fire; Type utility (Sp); Level 1; Burn 0 You can use your inner flame to reproduce the effects of a flare, light, or sparkAPG cantrip, except that the light you create with light produces heat like a normal flame; using any of the three abilities ends any previous light effect from this wild talent.
